intent: Land on the app and see the intro/start screen
expectation: The page shows an intro with a start button and description of the test

intent: Click Start test to begin the quiz
expectation: Clicking Start test will show Question 1 of 5 with a visual puzzle and answer options

intent: Select Option A as the answer for Question 1
expectation: Option A will become visually selected/pressed, and the Next button will become enabled

args.name: Option A — 3 half large circles, rotated 270°

intent: Click Next to advance from Q1 to Q2
expectation: Q2 will appear with a new puzzle and no pre-selected answer

intent: Select Option A as the answer for Question 2
expectation: Option A will be selected/pressed and Next → will become enabled

args.name: Option A — 1 outline small circle, rotated 270°

intent: Click Restart to find the start-over mechanism, observe whether app warns about progress loss
expectation: A confirmation dialog will appear asking whether to discard progress; dismissing it will keep my test intact

dialogs.message: Discard your current test and start over?

intent: Click Restart and accept the confirmation to truly discard progress and start over
expectation: Accepting the dialog will return me to the intro screen with no quiz state carried over

dialogs.message: Discard your current test and start over?

intent: Click Start test after restart to confirm truly fresh test state — Q1 with no pre-selections
expectation: Q1 will appear with a puzzle, no option is pre-selected ([pressed]), and Next → is disabled
